title.title: Title missing or not 10-60 characters
title.why: search results and browser tabs show the title and cut long ones off
title.fix: give the page a <title> of 10 to 60 characters that says what it is

description.title: Meta description missing or not 50-160 characters
description.why: search engines then show a random bit of the page, or cut it off
description.fix: add <meta name='description' content='...'> of 50 to 160 characters

one_h1.title: Not exactly one h1 heading
one_h1.why: screen readers and search engines look for one main heading
one_h1.fix: give the page one <h1> that says what it is about; make other main headings <h2>

no_lang.title: No language on the <html> tag
no_lang.why: screen readers may read the page in the wrong language
no_lang.fix: add it, for example <html lang='nl'> or <html lang='en'>

no_viewport.title: No viewport meta tag
no_viewport.why: phones show the desktop layout zoomed out, with tiny text

noindex.title: Search engines are told not to list this page (noindex)
noindex.why: it will not show up in search: right for private pages, wrong for public ones
noindex.fix: remove noindex if people should find this page

share_tags.title: Search and sharing tags missing
share_tags.why: copies of the page (?utm=...) compete in search and shared links look bare
share_tags.fix: add <link rel='canonical'>, og:title and og:image (your own image)

pwa.title: Installable-app (PWA) tags missing
pwa.why: without a linked manifest, phones cannot install the site as an app; without theme-color and an apple-touch-icon it looks plain on the home screen
pwa.fix: only if it should be an installable app: link a web app manifest (name, icons of 192 and 512 px), add theme-color and an apple-touch-icon (see the PWA section of forge-plan/profiles.md)

img_alt.title: Images without alt text
img_alt.why: screen readers read out the file name or skip the image
img_alt.fix: add alt='what the image shows', or alt='' when it is only decoration

no_label.title: Form fields without a label
no_label.why: screen reader users do not know what to fill in; a placeholder is not a label
no_label.fix: add a <label for='the-field-id'> or an aria-label to each field

no_name.title: Links or buttons without text
no_name.fix: add text, or an aria-label when it shows only an icon (alt on an image button, value on an input button)

heading_skip.title: Heading levels skip a step
heading_skip.why: screen reader users jump by headings and lose the outline
heading_skip.fix: go one level at a time (h1, h2, h3) and set the size with CSS

tabindex.title: Positive tabindex
tabindex.why: the Tab key jumps around out of page order

heavy.title: Heavy page
heavy.why: every kilobyte and file is another wait before the page works, worst on phones
heavy.fix: bundle scripts and styles, move inline data and SVGs into files, paginate long lists

blocking.title: Scripts in <head> hold up the page
blocking.why: the browser shows nothing until each one has downloaded and run
blocking.fix: add defer (or async when no other script needs it), or use type='module'

no_size.title: Images without width and height
no_size.why: the page jumps while they load

no_lazy.title: Many images, none lazy-loaded
no_lazy.why: every image downloads at once, even far down the page
no_lazy.fix: add loading='lazy' to images below the first screen

other_hosts.title: Files from other hosts
other_hosts.why: every visit sends the visitor's IP address to each of these hosts before any consent (AVG/GDPR: a problem for fonts and analytics, which can be self-hosted or wait for a yes); each host also slows the page, and a script there can change it
other_hosts.fix: self-host fonts, scripts and images; load analytics only after a yes in the cookie banner; name the outside companies left in the privacy policy

mixed_blocked.title: Scripts, styles, frames, embeds or forms use http:// on an https page
mixed_blocked.why: browsers block them, so parts of the page break; a form would send its data unencrypted
mixed_blocked.fix: use https:// addresses; an http:// <base href> makes every relative address http:// too

mixed_media.title: Images, media or fonts use http:// on an https page
mixed_media.why: browsers upgrade or block them and may mark the page as not secure
mixed_media.fix: use https:// addresses for every image, video, font and CSS url()
